# Parole
- 1.
 To ensure the continued output of departments, the Marine Police is encouraged to provide Parole when sensible.

 1.1
 Parole may be applied as the result of a trial, or at the Marine Quartermaster or Marine CO's discretion. - 2.
 Paroled Prisoners are to be released from the Marine Police and marked "Paroled" in the Criminal Records System. - 3.
 The Marine Quartermaster or Marine CO may request the paroled individual to "check in" with the Marine Police during the duration of their parole. 3.1
 Failure to comply in under 5 minutes is to be considered breach of custody.

 3.2
 This should not be done more than every 15 minutes.

 3.3
 Paroled individuals may be searched at all times by the Marine Police. - 4.
 When the sentence is up, the parolee may return to the Marine Police to retrieve any temporarily confiscated equipment, such as tools.
